purpose: Whole-tree clean replay of the Lean project of release v1.11.0 (adds Paper 8 version 2).
procedure: Fresh directory; only sources and configuration copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean, Research/**/*.lean, Comparator/*.lean, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, lean-toolchain); .lake/packages is a symlink to the shared Lake package cache of Mathlib and its dependencies at the pinned revisions (every package HEAD equal to lake-manifest.json, no tracked changes); fresh .lake/build (absent before the first build). No download.
Environment for every Lake and Lean run: PATH starts with the toolchain bin; LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2; LAKE_NO_CACHE=true, LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false, LAKE_RESTORE_ARTIFACTS=false.

R1, holding both Lean lock slots: read-only deps guard (`lake --no-build build +Research.AxialMSZ.Challenge:deps +Research.CirculantQ3:deps`); `lake build Research.CirculantQ3` alone; `lake build` (default target Research, which imports the Check modules of Papers 3, 4, 8, 9 and 10); `lake build` of the twelve audit modules; `lake build` of the five ChallengeTests modules (Papers 3, 4, 8, 9 and 10); `lake build` of the modules not reached from Research.lean (the further known-answer tests of Paper 8, Research.Backfill.Paper8.Proof.Tests.*).

R2, one lock slot: the twelve audit files run with `lake env lean --threads=2` (plain text and --json); `lake env leanchecker <Module>` for every module except CirculantQ3 and the root module, two at a time; forbidden-token scan of every .lean file under Research/ and Research.lean; `shasum -a 256 -c` of the replay manifest against the release tree lean/.
R3, both lock slots: `lake env leanchecker Research.CirculantQ3`.

Axiom audit: every `#print axioms` output of the build logs (CirculantQ3, default target, ChallengeTests, other modules) and of the JSON output of the audit files, position-matched to the `#print axioms` commands in the .lean files.
notes: Written by make_receipt.py from the logs listed above; paths are logical names.
